'''Giovanni's Beedrill''' (Japanese: '''サカキのスピアー''' ''Sakaki's Spear'') is {{adv|Giovanni}}'s [[List of characters' first Pokémon|first Pokémon]] in the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga. He is at [[level]] 70 and his [[Characteristic]] is that he is "quick tempered."

==History==
==={{MangaArc|Red, Green & Blue}}===
[[File:Giovanni Beedrill pinning Red.png|thumb|left|175px|Beedrill pinning Red down]]
Prior to the start of the series, {{adv|Giovanni}} caught {{p|Beedrill}} when he was a {{p|Weedle}} at [[Viridian Forest]] when he was a young [[Pokémon Trainer]]. Sometime after this he [[Evolution|evolved]] into a {{p|Kakuna}} and then into Beedrill. Since then, Giovanni has used Beedrill as a reliable partner in many situations as the boss of [[Team Rocket]]. He notes that while he prefers to use Pokémon of his {{t|Ground|specialty type}}, his origins have given him a profound significance in his heart.

Beedrill first appeared in ''[[PS037|Golly, Golem!]]'', battling in Giovanni's [[Gym]] battle against {{adv|Red}}. After Giovanni's {{p|Golem}} defeated Red's {{p|Snorlax}}, [[Snor]], he sent out Beedrill to corner Red with his stinger. Having Red trapped, Giovanni took the time to explain that he had read through each and every one of Red's decisions, ensuring that he would win. Asking Red to give up, Giovanni was surprised as Red released [[Aero]] from behind himself. Aero attacked with {{m|Hyper Beam}} and defeated Beedrill with a single hit.

==={{MangaArc|Yellow}}===
In ''[[PS088|The Beedrill All and End All]]'', Beedrill participated in Giovanni's battle against [[Lance]] at [[Cerise Island]]. Due to Lance surrounding himself and his Pokémon in an impenetrable bubble, Giovanni rolled Beedrill's [[Poké Ball]] underneath the main bubble. Beedrill came out of his ball and pierced the bubble with {{m|Twineedle}}, dropping Lance into the middle of a {{m|String Shot}} net made by {{adv|Yellow}}'s {{p|Caterpie}}, [[Kitty]], and entangling him. Beedrill then used his stinger to hold Lance at bay while Giovanni interrogated him. Despite this, Lance soon revealed that he had lured Giovanni into the center of the island on purpose in order to use his {{badge|Earth}} to activate his final plan.
[[File:Giovanni and Beedrill.png|thumb|180px|Beedrill and Giovanni]]
==={{MangaArc|Ruby & Sapphire}}===
At the end of the {{MangaArc|Ruby & Sapphire}}, as revealed in a flashback in ''[[PS601|Beedrill Prepares]]'', [[Blaise]] witnessed Giovanni taking {{i|Ruby|the}} {{i|Sapphire|gems}} formed from the shattered [[Red Orb|Red]] and [[Blue Orb]]s. While Blaise intended to take them back, Giovanni sensed his presence and sent out Beedrill. He did not order him to attack, however, as Blaise had retreated, having realized that he'd stand no chance against Giovanni.

==={{MangaArc|FireRed & LeafGreen}}===
In ''[[PS283|It Takes Patience, Knowledge and a Really Quick Beedrill]]'', Beedrill helped Giovanni capture {{adv|Deoxys|Organism No. 2}}. Using his {{m|Agility}}, Beedrill quickly backed Organism No. 2 into a corner, causing its {{m|Reflect|Delta}} {{m|Light Screen|Shield}} to quickly lose energy. Thanks to this, Giovanni's {{p|Aggron}} was able to break the shield with {{m|Brick Break}}, allowing Giovanni to capture it.

==={{MangaArc|Omega Ruby & Alpha Sapphire}}===
In [[PS613]], Beedrill appeared alongside Giovanni aboard [[Team Rocket airship|his airship]]. In [[PS616]], Beedrill was revealed to be able to [[Mega Evolution|Mega Evolve]]. Giovanni used his Mega Evolution to reveal that the meteoroid headed for [[Hoenn]] may be housing a Pokémon inside of it since Mega Evolution can only be used in battle with another Pokémon. In ''[[PAORAS21|Omega Alpha Adventure 21]]'', Beedrill assisted in stopping the [[Grand Meteor Delta]].
{{left clear}}

==Personality and characteristics==
Being {{adv|Giovanni}}'s first Pokémon, he and Beedrill have developed a strong bond that has lasted for years and he is often seen standing beside Giovanni. Despite not being Giovanni's {{t|Ground|specialty type}}, he prefers to use Beedrill, as he gives him a profound significance in his heart. He is fairly strong and is often used in Giovanni's battles, primarily as a way to pin down his opponents.
